pastes.subtitle: PHOTOGRAPHY GEAR
pastes.content:
Essentials

Cameras:
- Sony A6700 (kit)

Lenses:
- Sigma 24-70 f/2.8 DG DN II ART
- Sigma 10-18 f/2.8 (incoming)

Memory cards:
- SanDisk 128GB Extreme PRO UHS-I SDXC (with A6700 kit)
- SanDisk 128GB Extreme PRO UHS-II SDXC (maximum video quality)
- Lexar 256GB Professional 1667x UHS-II SDXC (main photography drive)

Tripods:
- Ulanzi & Coman Zero Y tripod

Flashes:
- Godox V1 PRO

Chargers:
- Anker Prime 160W USB-C Charger
- Anker 240W USB-C Cables (Pack of 3, 1.5m)
- Jupio tri-charge for Sony NP-FZ100 (also card holder)

Batteries:
- Sony NP-FZ100 (3x)
- Godox VB-30 (1x)


Accessories

Lens filters:
- B+W MRC Nano Master UV Filter 67mm (16x Coated, Slim, Premium)
- PolarPro 82mm QuartzLine Circular Polarizer
- Hoya UV-HMC 82mm

Filter adapters:
- 67-82mm Step-Up Adapter Ring

Cleaning kit:
- Lens pen
- OXO Cleaning Pen
- Generic air blower

Support & mounting:
- Peak Design Slide Camera Strap
- Peak Design Capture Clip v3
- Peak Design Pro Pad for Capture Clip v3
- Peak Design Cuff Camera Wrist
- Sony Strap
- Pikachu Hot Shoe Cover

Belt carry system (Germany trip):
- C-Rope Neoprene Lens Pouch Large (€16.90)
- C-Rope Neoprene Lens Pouch Small (€15.90)
- C-Rope Neoprene Camera Bag Set (S, M, L)
- Matador Universal Strap Pocket (€34.95)
- JUKMO Tactical Belt

Card management:
- SanDisk UHS-II USB-C Card Reader


Computing & Workflow

Mobile editing:
- Samsung Galaxy Tab S9+


Bags & Transport

Backpacks:
- K&F Concept Beta Photography Backpack 20L (primary—Germany trip)
- Ruggard Hunter 35 DSLR Holster (with A6700 kit)

Accessories:
- AK-R1 flash kit
